kamisato-ayaka.summary: Ayaka dashes with her Alternate Sprint to coat her blade in Cryo, then cuts with Normal and Charged Attacks between Bursts. Soumetsu, her Burst, is the storm that does most of her damage. With a Hydro partner keeping enemies Frozen, Blizzard Strayer hands her up to 40% CRIT Rate for free, so she builds almost all CRIT DMG. Freeze is still where she shines.
kamisato-ayaka.consNote: C0 does the job. Constellations add damage, not a new playstyle.
